info.name: ZT Security - MCP and AI Agent
info.description: Source-based local workflow. Select ZT Local environment. Send requests individually; do not run the entire collection: setup and policy changes plus actual cancellation are included. No build or live request verification performed. Admin and service identities are separate. Secrets are blank except default development admin key. Existing client secrets cannot be retrieved. AI client needs its own IDE environment secret.

item.name: 00 - Demo order data (direct upstream setup)
item.description: Create isolated demo data via existing order REST API. Direct status read is an independent check; governed cancellation must use ZT folders 03/05.

request.description: Creates a new order on every Send. Server generates its ID. Does not pass through ZT; data setup only.
